H3470A.name: Isaiah
H3470A.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3470A.brief: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.
H3470A.short: Isaiah was a prophet in Judah during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah. His prophecies are recorded in the biblical book bearing his name.

H3431.name: Ishbah
H3431.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3431.brief: Son of Mered in the genealogy of Judah
H3431.short: Ishbah's sons were the  father (ie founder) of Eshtemoa and Keilah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah..

H3435.name: Ishbak
H3435.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3435.short: Ishbak was a son of Abraham and his concubine Keturah.

H3430.name: Ishbi-benob
H3430.desc: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
H3430.brief: Philistine giant who fought against David's men.
H3430.short: Ishbi-benob, a Philistine giant, was killed by David's warrior Abishai when he threatened David's life.

H3469G.name: Ishi
H3469G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3469G.brief: Son of Appaim, descendant of Judah.
H3469G.short: Ishi was a descendant of Judah through Appaim.

H3469H.name: Ishi
H3469H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3469H.brief: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah.
H3469H.short: Ishi was a son of Shimon, a descendant of Judah.

H3469I.name: Ishi
H3469I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3469I.brief: Leader of Simeonites who attacked Hamites in Gedor.
H3469I.short: Ishi was one of the leaders of the Simeonites who attacked the Hamites in Gedor during the days of Hezekiah.

H3469J.name: Ishi
H3469J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3469J.brief: Head of a father's house in Manasseh.
H3469J.short: Ishi was a head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh.

H3457.name: Ishma
H3457.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3457.brief: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah.
H3457.short: Ishma was a son of Hur, a descendant of Judah.

H3458I.name: Ishmael
H3458I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3458I.brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Saul's line.
H3458I.short: Ishmael was a descendant of Benjamin through King Saul's line.

H3458J.name: Ishmael
H3458J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3458J.short: Ishmael son of Jehohanan was a leader in Judah during King Jehoshaphat's reign.

H3458K.name: Ishmael
H3458K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3458K.brief: Son of Jehohanan; supported Joash as king.
H3458K.short: Ishmael was the son of Jehohanan, who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

H3458H.name: Ishmael
H3458H.desc: Jeremiah's adversary living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3458H.brief: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.
H3458H.short: Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, assassinated Gedaliah the governor and led captives to Ammon before being pursued by Johanan.

H3458L.name: Ishmael
H3458L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3458L.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time.
H3458L.short: Ishmael was a priest who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

H3458G.name: Ishmael
H3458G.desc: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3458G.brief: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.
H3458G.short: Ishmael, the son of Abraham and Hagar, was the ancestor of various Arab tribes. Though not the chosen heir, he was still blessed by God.

H3460G.name: Ishmaiah
H3460G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3460G.brief: Gibeonite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3460G.short: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite was a mighty warrior among the Thirty who joined David at Ziklag.

H3460H.name: Ishmaiah
H3460H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3460H.brief: Leader of the tribe of Zebulun under David.
H3460H.short: Ishmaiah son of Obadiah was the leader of the tribe of Zebulun during King David's reign.

H3461.name: Ishmerai
H3461.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3461.short: Ishmerai was a descendant of Benjamin through Elpaal.

H3472.name: Ishpah
H3472.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3472.short: Ishpah was a descendant of Benjamin through Beriah.

H3473.name: Ishpan
H3473.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3473.short: Ishpan was a descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.

H3438.name: Ishvah
H3438.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3438.brief: Son of Asher, grandson of Jacob.
H3438.short: Ishvah was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob.

H3440G.name: Ishvi
H3440G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3440G.brief: Son of Asher, grandson of Jacob.
H3440G.short: Ishvi (or Isui) was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob.

H3478.name: Israel
H3478.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3478.brief: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes
H3478.short: Israel, also named Jacob, was the son of Isaac, the father of the twelve tribes of Israel, and a key patriarch of the Jewish people.

H3485H.name: Issachar
H3485H.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3485H.brief: Son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in David's time.
H3485H.short: Issachar was a son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in the time of King David.

H3485G.name: Issachar
H3485G.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3485G.brief: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe
H3485G.short: Issachar was the ninth son of Jacob and fifth by Leah, and he became the forefather of the Israelite tribe of Issachar.

H3449H.name: Isshiah
H3449H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3449H.brief: Korahite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3449H.short: Isshiah the Korahite was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

H3449I.name: Isshiah
H3449I.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3449I.brief: Levite, grandson of Rehabiah during David's reign.
H3449I.short: Isshiah was a Levite, the son of Rehabiah and grandson of Moses, who served during King David's reign.

H3449J.name: Isshiah
H3449J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3449J.brief: Levite, descendant of Rehabiah during David's reign.
H3449J.short: Isshiah (or Jeshaiah) was a Levite, a descendant of Rehabiah, who served during King David's reign.

H3449G.name: Isshiah
H3449G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3449G.brief: Son of Izrahiah, descendant of Issachar.
H3449G.short: Isshiah was a son of Izrahiah and a descendant of Issachar.

H3449K.name: Isshijah
H3449K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3449K.brief: Descendant of Harim; agreed to put away foreign wife.
H3449K.short: Isshijah, a descendant of Harim, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

H3495.name: Ithmah
H3495.desc: Moabite warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3495.short: Ithmah the Moabite was one of the mighty warriors in David's army.

H3402H.name: Jarib
H3402H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3402H.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman
H3402H.short: Jarib was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H3402G.name: Jarib
H3402G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3402G.brief: Leader sent by Ezra to find Levites
H3402G.short: Jarib was one of the leaders sent by Ezra to find Levites to serve in the Temple.

H3477H.name: Jashar
H3477H.brief: Ancient Hebrew book mentioned in the Old Testament
H3477H.short: Jashar was an ancient Hebrew book mentioned in the Old Testament, but not included in the biblical canon.

H3464G.name: Jashen
H3464G.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H3464G.brief: Father of some of David's mighty men
H3464G.short: Jashen, also known as Hashem, was the father of some of David's mighty men.

H3434H.name: Jashobeam
H3434H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3434H.brief: Korahite who joined David at Ziklag
H3434H.short: Jashobeam was a Korahite who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

H3434G.name: Jashobeam
H3434G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3434G.brief: Chief of David's mighty men, Hachmoni's son
H3434G.short: Jashobeam, also known as Josheb-basshebet, was the chief of David's mighty men and the son of Hachmoni.

H3437G.name: Jashub
H3437G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3437G.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
H3437G.short: Jashub was an Israelite who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H3437H.name: Jashub
H3437H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3437H.brief: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob
H3437H.short: Jashub, also known as Yob, was a son of Issachar and a grandson of Jacob.

H3496.name: Jathniel
H3496.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3496.short: Jathniel was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H3413.name: Jeremai
H3413.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3413.brief: A descendant of Hashum who married a foreign wife.
H3413.short: Jeremai, a descendant of Hashum, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

H3414J.name: Jeremiah
H3414J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414J.brief: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3414J.short: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H3414K.name: Jeremiah
H3414K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414K.brief: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3414K.short: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H3414I.name: Jeremiah
H3414I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414I.brief: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3414I.short: Jeremiah was one of the Gadite warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H3414H.name: Jeremiah
H3414H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414H.brief: A leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
H3414H.short: Jeremiah was one of the leaders of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the time of the Chronicles.

H3414L.name: Jeremiah
H3414L.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414L.brief: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.
H3414L.short: Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, was a prophet who ministered during the reigns of the last kings of Judah, warning of the Babylonian exile and calling for repentance.

H3414G.name: Jeremiah
H3414G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414G.short: Jeremiah of Libnah was the father of Hamutal, who was the mother of King Jehoahaz and King Zedekiah of Judah.

H3414N.name: Jeremiah
H3414N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3414N.short: Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, was a Rechabite who was tested by the prophet Jeremiah for his obedience to his ancestor's commands.

H3414M.name: Jeremiah
H3414M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3414M.brief: A priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.
H3414M.short: Jeremiah was one of the priests who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, as recorded in Nehemiah.

H3406H.name: Jeremoth
H3406H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3406H.short: Jeremoth was a son of Becher and a member of the tribe of Benjamin, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3406I.name: Jeremoth
H3406I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3406I.brief: Son of Beriah, a Benjamite leader in Jerusalem.
H3406I.short: Jeremoth, the son of Beriah, was a leader of the Benjamites living in Jerusalem, as recorded in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3406P.name: Jeremoth
H3406P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3406P.brief: A descendant of Elam who married a foreign wife.
H3406P.short: Jeremoth, a descendant of Elam, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

H3406Q.name: Jeremoth
H3406Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3406Q.brief: A descendant of Zattu who married a foreign wife.
H3406Q.short: Jeremoth, a descendant of Zattu, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

H3406R.name: Jeremoth
H3406R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3406R.brief: A descendant of Bani who married a foreign wife.
H3406R.short: Jeremoth, a descendant of Bani, was among those who married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to send them away.

H3404G.name: Jeriah
H3404G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3404G.brief: A Levite, the firstborn son of Hebron.
H3404G.short: Jeriah was a Levite, the firstborn son of Hebron, and an ancestor of the Hebronites who served in the tabernacle during David's reign.

H3403.name: Jeribai
H3403.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3403.short: Jeribai was listed among David's mighty men, a group of skilled warriors who fought alongside him.

H3400.name: Jeriel
H3400.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3400.brief: A son of Tola, from the tribe of Issachar.
H3400.short: Jeriel was one of the sons of Tola and a leader in the tribe of Issachar, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3404H.name: Jerijah
H3404H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3404H.brief: A Levite leader during David's reign.
H3404H.short: Jerijah was a Levite leader from the family of Hebron who served during the reign of King David.

H3406J.name: Jerimoth
H3406J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3406J.brief: One of David's warriors from the tribe of Benjamin.
H3406J.short: Jerimoth was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H3406K.name: Jerimoth
H3406K.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3406K.brief: A Levite, son of Mushi, from the Merari clan.
H3406K.short: Jerimoth was a Levite, the son of Mushi, from the clan of Merari, as recorded in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles.

H3406L.name: Jerimoth
H3406L.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3406L.brief: A Levite, son of Heman the singer.
H3406L.short: Jerimoth was a son of Heman, the Levitical singer, and was appointed by King David to serve in the tabernacle choir.

H3406M.name: Jerimoth
H3406M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3406M.brief: Son of Azriel, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.
H3406M.short: Jerimoth, the son of Azriel, was a leader from the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David.

H3406G.name: Jerimoth
H3406G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3406G.brief: Son of Bela, from the tribe of Benjamin.
H3406G.short: Jerimoth was a son of Bela and a leader in the tribe of Benjamin, as mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3406N.name: Jerimoth
H3406N.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H3406N.short: Jerimoth was a son of King David and Abihail, the daughter of Eliab, David's brother.

H3406O.name: Jerimoth
H3406O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3406O.brief: A Levite overseer during Hezekiah's temple restoration.
H3406O.short: Jerimoth was a Levite appointed as an overseer during King Hezekiah's restoration of the temple and its services.

H3408.name: Jerioth
H3408.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3408.brief: Wife of Caleb; mother of unnamed children.
H3408.short: Jerioth was one of the wives of Caleb, and she bore him some unnamed children, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3470H.name: Jeshaiah
H3470H.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3470H.brief: A Levite, son of Jeduthun the musician.
H3470H.short: Jeshaiah was a Levite, the son of Jeduthun, and a musician appointed by King David to serve in the tabernacle choir.

H3470B.name: Jeshaiah
H3470B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3470B.brief: A descendant of Shecaniah from the line of David.
H3470B.short: Jeshaiah was a descendant of Shecaniah, from the royal line of David, mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H3470J.name: Jeshaiah
H3470J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3470J.brief: A Levite who accompanied Ezra to Jerusalem.
H3470J.short: Jeshaiah was a Levite who accompanied Ezra on his journey from Babylon to Jerusalem.

H3470I.name: Jeshaiah
H3470I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3470I.brief: A descendant of Elam who returned with Ezra.
H3470I.short: Jeshaiah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H3470K.name: Jeshaiah
H3470K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3470K.brief: A descendant of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem.
H3470K.short: Jeshaiah, a descendant of Benjamin, was among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3428.name: Jeshebeab
H3428.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3428.brief: Head of the fourteenth priestly division.
H3428.short: Jeshebeab was the head of the fourteenth division of priests during the time of David.

H3475.name: Jesher
H3475.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3475.brief: A son of Caleb and Azubah.
H3475.short: Jesher was one of the sons of Caleb and his wife Azubah, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3454.name: Jeshishai
H3454.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3454.short: Jeshishai was an ancestor of the Gadite leaders who lived in Bashan, as mentioned in the genealogy of Gad in 1 Chronicles.

H3439.name: Jeshohaiah
H3439.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3439.brief: A leader from the tribe of Simeon.
H3439.short: Jeshohaiah was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the time of King Hezekiah.

H3442G.name: Jeshua
H3442G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3442G.brief: Head of a priestly family that returned from exile.
H3442G.short: Jeshua was the head of a priestly family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H3442H.name: Jeshua
H3442H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3442H.brief: A Levite during King Hezekiah's reign.
H3442H.short: Jeshua was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

H3442J.name: Jeshua
H3442J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3442J.brief: A prominent Levite leader during the post-exilic period.
H3442J.short: Jeshua was a prominent Levite leader who played a significant role in the restoration of Jerusalem and the temple after the Babylonian exile.

H3442I.name: Jeshua
H3442I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3442I.brief: Leader of a group that returned from Babylonian exile.
H3442I.short: Jeshua was the leader of a group of Israelites who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H3442K.name: Jeshua
H3442K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3442K.brief: A priest who received the temple treasures.
H3442K.short: Jeshua was a priest who received the temple treasures brought back from Babylon during the return from exile.

H3442N.name: Jeshua
H3442N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3442N.brief: A Levite leader during Nehemiah's time.
H3442N.short: Jeshua was a Levite leader who served during the time of Nehemiah and participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

H3442L.name: Jeshua
H3442L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3442L.brief: Son of Jozadak, who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall.
H3442L.short: Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, was a high priest who helped rebuild a section of Jerusalem's wall during the time of Nehemiah.

H3450.name: Jesimiel
H3450.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3450.brief: A leader from the tribe of Simeon.
H3450.short: Jesimiel was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3448.name: Jesse
H3448.desc: David's father living at the time of United Monarchy
H3448.short: Jesse was the father of King David and an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

H3421.name: Jorkeam
H3421.desc: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3421.brief: A son or town founded by Raham
H3421.short: Jorkeam was a descendant of Caleb or a town founded by Raham in the tribe of Judah.

H3436.name: Joshbekashah
H3436.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3436.brief: A son of Heman, a musician in David's time
H3436.short: Joshbekashah, one of Heman's sons, was a musician appointed by King David to lead worship.

H3416.name: Irpeel
H3416.short: Irpeel, a town in the territory of Benjamin (<ref="Joshua 18:27">Joshua 18:27</ref>).

H3494.name: Ithlah
H3494.short: Ithlah, a town in the territory of Dan (<ref="Joshua 19:42">Joshua 19:42</ref>).

H3497.name: Ithnan
H3497.brief: A town in the Negev of Judah
H3497.short: Ithnan, a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:23">Joshua 15:23</ref>).

H3412G.name: Jarmuth
H3412G.brief: A Canaanite city, later allotted to Judah
H3412G.short: Jarmuth, a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, later allotted to Judah.

H3412H.name: Jarmuth
H3412H.short: Jarmuth, a Levitical city in the territory of Issachar (<ref="Joshua 21:29">Joshua 21:29</ref>).

H3492.name: Jattir
H3492.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H3492.short: Jattir, a town in the hill country of Judah, later a Levitical city.

H3405G.name: Jericho
H3405G.brief: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel
H3405G.short: Jericho, an ancient Canaanite city famously conquered by the Israelites under Joshua's leadership.

H3466G.name: Jeshanah
H3466G.brief: A town captured by Abijah from Jeroboam
H3466G.short: Jeshanah, a town captured by King Abijah of Judah from Jeroboam of Israel (<ref="2Ch.13.19">2Ch.13.19</ref>).

H3452G.name: Jeshimon
H3452G.brief: A wilderness near Ziph, where David hid from Saul
H3452G.short: Jeshimon, a wilderness near Ziph where David hid from Saul (<ref="1Sa.23.19, 24; 26:1, 3">1Sa.23.19, 24; 26:1, 3</ref>).

H3442M.name: Jeshua
H3442M.brief: A town in Judah inhabited after the Babylonian exile
H3442M.short: Jeshua, a town in Judah inhabited by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Nehemiah 11:26">Nehemiah 11:26</ref>).

H3465G.name: Yeshanah Gate
H3465G.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
H3465G.short: The Yeshanah Gate, also known as the Old Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall rebuilt by Nehemiah (<ref="Neh. 3:6; 12:39">Neh. 3:6; 12:39</ref>).
